rule: guideline §21 R3 — every party the source document's own preamble defines, proper names and defined roles alike; never collectives, distributives, relational references, or unnamed third parties
casing_warning: §21 R2 — resolve_party() matches `aliases` CASE-SENSITIVELY (`:alias = ANY(aliases)`) and `canonical_name` case-insensitively. Alias entries MUST carry the exact casing as it appears in a span.
annotator_notes: Provider and Recipient are registered as parties IN THEIR OWN RIGHT, not as aliases of RGHI/RCP. The preamble defines them as role designations either party may occupy: 'Each Party or any of its Affiliates providing services hereunder shall be a "Provider," and each Party or any of its Affiliates receiving services hereunder shall be a "Recipient."' Aliasing them to a specific entity would be factually wrong. §21 R3 covers this: the registry holds proper names AND defined roles. REVIEWER JUDGMENT CALL.
